mapper.select: SELECT SF.FILE_NO, SF.STORE_NO, SF.FILE_PATH, SF.FILE_NAME, SF.ORIGIN_NAME, SF.IS_MAIN FROM STORE_FILE SF INNER JOIN STORE S ON SF.STORE_NO = S.STORE_NO INNER JOIN STORE_USER SU ON S.S_USER_ID = SU.S_USER_ID WHERE S.S_USER_ID = #{sUserId} AND S.S_STATUS IN ('GEN', 'AFF') AND SU.U_STATUS = 'APR' ORDER BY SF.IS_MAIN DESC, SF.FILE_NO DESC

SELECT S.STORE_NO, S.STORE_NAME, S.S_CATEGORY, S.BIZNUM, S.IS_OPEN, S.ACC_NAME, S.ACC_NO, S.ACC_HOLDER, S.S_ADDR, S.S_FULL_ADDR, SD.SUB_TITLE, SD.S_CONTENTS, SP.SLOT, SP.CAPACITY, SP.CUTOFF, SP.OPEN_TIME, SP.CLOSE_TIME, SP.BREAK_START, SP.BREAK_END, SP.OFF_DAY, SP.REFUND_POLICY FROM STORE S INNER JOIN STORE_USER SU ON S.S_USER_ID = SU.S_USER_ID LEFT JOIN STORE_DETAIL SD ON S.STORE_NO = SD.STORE_NO LEFT JOIN STORE_POLICY SP ON S.STORE_NO = SP.STORE_NO WHERE S.S_USER_ID = #{sUserId} AND S.S_STATUS IN ('GEN', 'AFF') AND SU.U_STATUS = 'APR'

SELECT SM.MENU_NO, SM.STORE_NO, SM.MENU_NAME, SM.MENU_INFO, SM.MENU_PRICE, SM.REQ_TIME, SM.M_STATUS, SM.MENU_CATEGORY, CASE WHEN SM.M_STATUS = 'Y' THEN '판매중' WHEN SM.M_STATUS = 'N' THEN '판매중지' ELSE '미정' END AS M_STATUS_NAME FROM STORE S INNER JOIN STORE_USER SU ON S.S_USER_ID = SU.S_USER_ID INNER JOIN STORE_MENU SM ON S.STORE_NO = SM.STORE_NO WHERE S.S_USER_ID = #{sUserId} AND S.S_STATUS IN ('GEN', 'AFF') AND SU.U_STATUS = 'APR' ORDER BY SM.MENU_NO DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO STORE_FILE ( STORE_NO, FILE_PATH, FILE_NAME, ORIGIN_NAME, IS_MAIN, FILE_SIZE, FILE_EXT ) VALUES ( #{storeNo}, #{filePath}, #{fileName}, #{originName}, #{isMain}, #{fileSize}, #{fileExt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE STORE SET IS_OPEN = #{isOpen}, ACC_NAME = #{accName}, ACC_NO = #{accNo}, ACC_HOLDER = #{accHolder} WHERE STORE_NO = #{storeNo}

UPDATE STORE_POLICY SET CAPACITY = #{capacity}, OPEN_TIME = #{openTime}, CLOSE_TIME = #{closeTime}, BREAK_START = #{breakStart}, BREAK_END = #{breakEnd}, OFF_DAY = #{offDay}, REFUND_POLICY = #{refundPolicy} WHERE STORE_NO = #{storeNo}

UPDATE STORE_MENU SET MENU_NAME = #{menuName}, MENU_CATEGORY = #{menuCategory}, MENU_INFO = #{menuInfo}, MENU_PRICE = #{menuPrice}, REQ_TIME = #{reqTime}, M_STATUS = #{mStatus} WHERE MENU_NO = #{menuNo}
mapper.select: SELECT S_USER_ID, CEO_NAME FROM STORE_USER WHERE S_USER_ID = #{sUserId}
